title: fix(plugin-detail): the mirror’s `hideFields` declaration reaches its read site in `record-details.tsx` (objectui#9965)
body:
Fixes #9965

`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` read `hideFields` through `(schema as any)` — the one key of the four it casts that the mirror **declares**. A cast spends the declaration at the site it exists for, so the mirror alignment objectui#8649 landed never reached the read.

**⚠️ What the un-cast does NOT buy.** `RecordDetailsRendererProps['schema']` is `RecordDetailsComponentProps` **intersected with** an index signature admitting any key at `any`, so a **misspelled** key still type-checks at this site even un-cast. What the repair buys is **wrong-TYPE refusal of the correct spelling**, ⛔ not misspelling refusal. Narrowing that index signature is a different card and is deliberately not attempted here; the limit is pinned as a ledger leg with a control, so it cannot rot into prose.

Clause-②: no

Un-casting a read of a key the mirror **already declares** publishes nothing and accepts nothing new. Re-derived from this diff: the change is two tokens removed from one expression plus comments and a test. It adds no member to any exported interface, widens no schema, and introduces no new authorable key. The published-output measurement in the changeset is the mechanical half of the same claim.

## Step 1 — the census, re-taken at this branch point before any edit

The card cites `8f37c4e90`. Re-measured at my branch point `63f4f928f`, and the two agree: **6 matching LINES, 7 OCCURRENCES**. ⚠️ The card's "6 casts" is a **line** count — line 359 carried two casts. Nothing else moved between the two commits.

"Mirror declares?" is read off `RecordDetailsComponentProps` in `packages/types/src/record-components.ts` (read-only for this card). "Type carried" is `getTypeAtLocation` on the read expression itself — the only instrument that reports what a read actually carries, since a cast leaves membership intact.

| # | read, as written | key | mirror declares? | type carried BEFORE | type carried AFTER | action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `(schema as any).requiredPermissions` | `requiredPermissions` | **no** | `any` | `any` | left cast |
| 2 | `(schema as any).requiredPermissions` | `requiredPermissions` | **no** | `any` | `any` | left cast |
| 3 | `(schema as any).enforceFieldSecurity` | `enforceFieldSecurity` | **no** | `any` | `any` | left cast |
| 4 | `(schema as any).redactFields` | `redactFields` | **no** | `any` | `any` | left cast |
| 5 | `(schema as any).redactFields` | `redactFields` | **no** | `any` | `any` | left cast |
| 6 | `(schema as any).hideFields` | `hideFields` | **YES** | `any` | `string[] \| undefined` | **UN-CAST** |
| 7 | `(schema as any).hideFields` | `hideFields` | **YES** | `any` | `string[]` (narrowed) | **UN-CAST** |

⇒ **2 of 7 cast reads are over a declared key**, and the relayed census figure of **2 for this file is confirmed exactly**. Both are `hideFields`, both on the same line, in the highlight-dedup path.

**Why rows 1–5 stay cast.** The mirror declares `columns`, `sections`, `fields`, `hideFields`, `inlineEdit`, `showHeader`, `aria` — and none of `requiredPermissions`, `enforceFieldSecurity`, `redactFields`. A cast over a key the mirror does not declare is the honest spelling until someone declares it; un-casting them would change nothing anyway, because the index signature hands back `any` either way. They are **ledgered** in the pin with the expiry condition — each leg asserts the key is **still absent from the mirror**, so the day one is declared this file goes red instead of the exemption outliving its premise.

**Three reads excluded from the class, with the reason.** `schema.fields as any[]` and `schema.sections as any[]` (twice) cast the **value** the read produces, not `schema` itself — measured, the declaration **does** reach those reads (`string[] | undefined` and the section object type). `(ctx as any).objectSchema` and `ctx.recordId as any` are not reads off `schema` at all. None is in this card's class and none is touched.

## The pin, and why a behavioural one would have proved nothing

`as any` is erased before anything runs, so the defect and the repair have **identical runtime behaviour** — any behavioural test is green on both. The new file `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.hideFieldsUncast-9965.test.ts` follows the package's own idiom for this class (`record-related-list.relationshipValueFieldUncast-9475.test.tsx`) and adds the instrument that idiom named but could not reach from a type alias:

- **Type-level legs** (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), with `Expect` / `Equal` direction proofs. ⚠️ Labelled as **membership-shaped and NOT the discriminator** — measured by ablation leg 1 below, not assumed.
- **⭐ Program leg** — builds a real `ts.Program` over the renderer and asserts, over a population **derived** from the renderer's own `schema` type through the checker, that no read of a mirror-declared key carries `any`. This is the leg that is red on the defect. It is the shape `scripts/__tests__/js-comment-mask-param-types-9324.test.ts` established.
- **Source-text legs** over a population **derived** from `RecordDetailsProps.shape`, with comments masked first, plus liveness legs so the negative guard cannot be satisfied by deleting the read.
- **Calibration legs** so `any` is provably a reachable verdict and an unresolved mirror reports as a named calibration failure rather than as a false regression.

## Ablation — predictions written before each leg ran

Mutations written by a refuse-on-zero-match script that re-reads the file from disk in both directions; restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under a `trap` on EXIT/INT/TERM; each restore proven by `git diff HEAD` empty **and** `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob (`8f46be664351ff3e853264c8e9e73910f627aea7`, matched on every leg).

| leg | mutation | predicted | observed | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1 ⭐** | put the cast back on both `hideFields` reads | pin RED on exactly 3 legs: the two program legs and the source-text guard | `vitest exit=1`, **3 failed / 8 passed** — precisely those three | **as predicted** |
| **1b** | same mutation, type-level half | `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` both stay **GREEN** | both `exit=0` | **as predicted** — the measured proof that an indexed access on the type is a membership question a cast leaves intact, and that the program leg is the discriminator |
| **2** | delete the read entirely | pin RED on the **liveness** legs only; the negative guard alone would be satisfied by the deletion | `vitest exit=1`, **2 failed / 9 passed** — both liveness legs; the "no cast stands" negative passed on its own | **as predicted** — the negative guard is not vacuous |
| **3** | build the package from each side of the change | emitted JS identical; a type assertion is erased before emit | **116 published files, 115 byte-identical** — every emitted JS file and every `.d.ts`. The one that moves is `renderers/record-details.d.ts.map`, a position table shifted by the added comment lines | **as predicted**, and it is what the empty-frontmatter changeset declares |

Leg 1 failure text, verbatim: `expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal []` · `expected [ 'string[] | undefined', 'string[]' ] to include 'any'` · the source-text liveness regex.

**`check:readme-exports` is a PREREQUISITE FAILURE, ⛔ not a red gate.** It exits 1 naming four unbuilt packages — `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-kanban`, none of them touched here — and then declares its own population **COLLAPSED**: `packagesRead 13 against a floor of 25`, `typesResolved 0 against 2`, `keysCompared 0 against 20`, and its own output says "this run proves nothing". It needs a whole-workspace build; only this card's dependency closure was built. CI builds the workspace and will measure it.

**Declared narrowing — `eslint`.** The repo-wide run is CI's (`pnpm lint` in the `Lint` workflow); I ran the package unit instead. Population read off eslint's own resolution, not guessed: **254 files**, counted from `--format json` output, 0 errors, 1092 pre-existing warnings, of which my two files carry 37 (35 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in the renderer, **two fewer than before** since the repair removes two, and 2 in the new test where `any` is the subject of the assertion). Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so **type-aware linting is not enabled** and no rule reads another file's types — this diff therefore cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

Nothing under objectui#9050's or objectui#10194's surfaces is touched. The diff is three files: the renderer, the new pin, the changeset.
